purpose: Accept a possibility while adding a condition or reservation.
keywords: Plain form + にしても; noun / な-adjective stem + にしても
Even if I participate, I will be a little late.
Even as a joke, that was a terrible way to put it.
Even if I do not buy it, I want to have a look.
formation: Plain form + にしても; noun / な-adjective stem + にしても
restrictions: Often means even if or even taking that as true.
mistake: The following clause should respond to the assumed situation.
